name: Heavenly Guilt -Kami no Inai Machi-
source:
There is a bar in a lawless city.
Main character is a cleaner to do shady jobs. He meets an innocent girl by chance, and that pulls him in a whirlpool of desire, love and hate.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
无政府状态的城市里有一家酒吧。
主人公是一名专门替人处理见不得光工作的清道夫。他偶然遇见一名天真少女，自此被卷入欲望、爱与憎恨的漩涡。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
